title: Planning Worker Result
description: Structured result from a read-only Worker that returns one executable plan as content. The Worker writes nothing; the Coordinator writes the plan document and one task file per entry in tasks, then verifies completeness: taskCount equals the length of tasks, and planContent ends with the exact line END OF PLAN. A result failing either check is a truncated or malformed attempt, never a plan.

planContent.description: The complete plan document rendered from the plan template, ending with the exact line END OF PLAN. Null only when status is blocked.

taskCount.description: Must equal the number of entries in tasks. The Coordinator rejects the result otherwise; this is the guard against silent truncation.

content.description: The complete task file rendered from the task template, including its header block.
